title: A Skid Steer Controller That Knows Slip: The Track It Really Turns On, the Speed the Ground Allows in a Turn, and Why the Plain Follower Slides Wide

artifact.note: a path follower for a skid steer vehicle: pure pursuit gives a curvature, the traction limit of the surface (lesson 23-05) caps the speed in the turn, and the wheel speeds are worked out with the effective track chi times B and the slip of the wheels (lesson 23-02), so the body turns as asked; run against a plant that has the real chi and slip
